hardware_anchor_scope: Official RX 480 retail launch with 4 GB and 8 GB SKUs; not a board manufacture date
reported_evidence: TechPowerUp reports an online-purchased 4 GB retail card populated with eight Samsung 8 Gbit parts matching the 8 GB card and speed bin; reports 8 GB operation after a configuration change.
scope: One described retail experiment, not every launch card or later lot. The original article returned 403 on this review; its first-person text was retrieved in the same publisher indexed news page.
reusable_pattern: A lower advertised capacity can coexist with the same higher-capacity parts and speed bin as a larger SKU; component commonality can motivate a cohort-specific forecast.
cause_status: Supply constraints are a contemporaneous reported explanation in S55, not an audited procurement/BOM cause; physical and functional report does not by itself identify manufacturer intent.

hardware_anchor_scope: No architecture or product introduction date assigned from these sources; the dated owner posts establish presence by their respective dates.
reported_evidence: An ASUS-hosted owner post states 8 GB physically installed with half disabled and links photographs. Separate 2019 owner reports describe 8 GB availability or operation, along with power and functional problems in other configurations.
scope: S84 is an owner statement, not ASUS endorsement or exhaustive capacity validation. S17 concerns several board/configuration reports, not paired observations of one manufacturing cohort. S85 documents a GIGABYTE 4 GB product, not the parts on the ASUS unit.
reusable_pattern: Older mining-card families provide a precedent for investigating capacity configuration and board-variant dependence; retain reported successes and failures together.
cause_status: The commercial or manufacturing reason for the reported restriction is unestablished; a mining label alone does not identify supply substitution or defective memory.

hardware_anchor_scope: NVIDIA publication introducing Pascal GP100/P100; not CMP 100-100 introduction or manufacture
reported_evidence: One owner reports two cards changing from 6144 to 12288 MiB in the dated trial. Separate supplied checker records cover 11264 MiB each with no reported failures; device association and uncovered addresses have stated limits.
scope: Two cards from one owner are not independent replication. Physical stack density and the fourth site remain unresolved. The generation date does not date the restriction or its discovery.
reusable_pattern: A prior HBM GPU generation has a capacity-configuration report, so the recurrence hypothesis is not limited to GA100 or to discrete GDDR memory.
cause_status: Physical manufacturing motive and the date the capacity restriction was adopted are unestablished; the observed change is an external owner report.

product: CMP 170HX 8 GB and 10 GB reported variants
hardware_anchor_scope: NVIDIA GA100/Ampere architecture publication; not a CMP 170HX board manufacture date
reported_evidence: External owner/community research reports 8-to-64 GB-class and 10-to-40 GB-class capacity changes while retaining the respective active memory widths. Variant exceptions and limits remain relevant.
scope: This ledger has not established the first report or first discovery date. Reports may share provenance; no original reproduction or universal lot result is claimed. Physical stack population remains disputed.
reusable_pattern: Capacity exposed behind already-active interfaces can be much smaller than a later reported usable configuration; compare geometry, product purpose and variant identity when forecasting related cohorts.
cause_status: Observed capacity configuration does not uniquely identify commercial segmentation, yield grading, supply substitution or the health of all excluded regions.
